Two CAS push loops (reconcile-bridge.yml commit-back and canary flush) remain in YAML byte-identical, tested verbatim, and allowlisted as documented exceptions in raw-git-write lint
Anti-rot test must pin canary workflow wiring and guard against accidental reintroduction of logic-bearing run-blocks beyond the verbatim-tested flush loop
